subject: Next steps: Dataspan private onramp — SDK auth, VPC endpoint & reranker validation
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Alex Holden <alex@dataspan.io>, R&D Platform Team <eng+platform@dataspan.io>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Jun 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: Dataspan private onramp — SDK auth, VPC endpoint & reranker validation

Hi Alex + team,

Thanks again for the time today — appreciate the clear signal that private connectivity and reranker quality are blockers for your initial rollout. Below is a concise recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum toward a small POC next sprint. I attached a short security matrix and an IP allowlist template to help your networking folks.

Call recap (short):
- Goal: Validate private onramp for model inference + embeddings/reranker in our hosted Dedicated topology, with strict egress controls and predictable latencies.
- Primary concerns: VPC endpoint topology, IP allowlists & egress SNI, DNS mapping for hostname-based routing, and mTLS for service-to-service authentication.
- Integration work: SDK auth (OIDC vs API key), structured-output/tool-calling shape for downstream reranker, and test dataset + scoring for embedding+rerank quality.

Open technical questions (please confirm):
1) VPC connectivity: Do you want AWS PrivateLink (interface endpoint) into our dedicated service, or are you leaning toward VPC peering/Transit Gateway? You mentioned PrivateLink as preferred — can your network team confirm constraints (IP addressing, NACLs)?
2) IP allowlist: Will you consume a fixed set of egress IPs from us, or do you prefer a DNS-based approach (CNAME to our endpoint)? We can provide both; we recommended static egress for stricter firewall rules.
3) DNS / SNI: For host-based routing we can issue a cname like api.dataspan.redwood.example -> our endpoint. Do you require a custom cert (mTLS with client cert) or will TLS + token/OIDC suffice for the initial PoC?
4) mTLS: Is mutual TLS mandatory for all calls, or only for admin/ingestion endpoints? If mandatory, please share your expected client cert rotation cadence and preferred CA (internal PKI vs ACM).
5) Auth model for SDK: We recommend OIDC short-lived tokens with a service account exchange for higher security. Are you able to support OIDC/OAuth2 flow, or will you need us to fall back to API keys initially?
6) Reranker validation: Please share a small eval set (100-500 queries) and success criteria (MRR / P@k / manual inspection). We can run an A/B vs your current production reranker.

Proposed next steps (timeline):
- Today: Alex to introduce network contact and share any constraints + initial answers to questions above (deadline: EOD Fri).
- Mon: Redwood (Priyom) creates a minimal SDK sample demonstrating OIDC token exchange + example structured output schema and tool calling hooks (deliverable: repo/sandbox token, ETA Tue).
- Tue/Wed: Joint networking call to map PrivateLink interface subnets, route tables, and any required VPC endpoint policy.
- By EOW: Run a first reranker smoke with a 100-query set and share a short report.

Attachments: dataspan_security_matrix.pdf (security checklist), ip_allowlist_template.csv (sample template).

If this looks right I’ll schedule the networking call with Priyom and Marissa on Monday.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Solutions — Redwood Inference

From: Alex Holden <alex@dataspan.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: R&D Platform Team <eng+platform@dataspan.io>, Nadia Li <nadia@dataspan.io>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Jun 2028 17:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: Dataspan private onramp — SDK auth, VPC endpoint & reranker validation

Ben — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers from the network/security side:

- PrivateLink is our preference (interface endpoint). We want to avoid peering complexity across multiple accounts.
- IP allowlist: security prefers a static set of egress IPs we can lock down, but we can accept DNS-based for initial testing. If you can provide the list of NAT/egress IPs for the PoC that'd be ideal.
- mTLS: required for writes/ingestion and admin API calls; read-only inference can use TLS + token for now. We use an internal CA but can accept client certs issued from ACM if needed. Rotation cadence is quarterly.
- DNS: We'll accept a CNAME; we'll need a CSR if you require a customer cert.
- Auth: We can support OIDC — we have an internal token exchange service. API key fallback is acceptable for the very first sandbox.

I'll loop in Nadia (network owner) to coordinate subnets and RFC for the PrivateLink interface. Nadia — can you share avail subnets and any account restrictions?

Alex
Alex Holden
Head of Platform — Dataspan
alex@dataspan.io

To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 8 Jun 2028 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Next steps: Dataspan private onramp — SDK auth, VPC endpoint & reranker validation

Priyom / Marissa — forwarding Alex's note and Nadia on the network side. Action items for Redwood:

- Priyom: can you stand up the OIDC sample (token exchange + short-lived token usage) and a tiny reranker harness that runs locally against our sandbox endpoint? Keep the sample language in Python and Node, and include env-var-driven host override so Dataspan can point at the PrivateLink DNS once provisioned. Attach to the repo: structured_output_schema.json and an example tool-calling prompt set.
- Marissa: please coordinate calendar with Nadia for Monday morning PST for a 45-min network mapping call. Bring our network diagram and the list of egress IPs we can commit for the PoC (we'll use NAT pools in the Dedicated cluster).
- Also include a note for the product side: the reranker harness should support an embeddings precompute step (small vector store) so we can reproduce their current flow.

Priyom — can you confirm ETA for the samples? Ideally by Tue EOD. If you need me to draft the structured output schema I can do a first pass.

Ben

Subject: Re: Next steps: Dataspan private onramp — SDK auth, VPC endpoint & reranker validation

Thanks Ben — will take this. Quick status and plan:

Planned deliverables (ETA Tue 2028-06-12 EOD):
- repo: redwood/dataspan-onramp-samples with Python + Node minimal SDK snippets demonstrating OIDC exchange (service-account JWT -> short-lived token) and a host override flag.
- reranker-harness: small harness (pytest-compatible) that runs an embedding + rerank flow on a 100-query sample. Will include instructions to switch the endpoint to the PrivateLink FQDN and an example production-like scoring script.
- structured_output_schema.json: minimal JSON schema for our tool-calling + structured outputs (fields: action, args, confidence).

Network coordination: I can join the Monday networking call; Marissa please propose 09:00-11:00 PST slots.

Notes / questions for Dataspan (Alex / Nadia):
- Can you share the subnet IDs you intend to use for the PrivateLink ENIs and whether NAT is required on your side? (We typically publish a small set of egress IPs but need to map routing.)
- For mTLS, we'll support client cert verification on ingestion endpoints. If you're using an internal CA, we'll need the CA bundle for verification.

I'll post the repo link and sandbox token once created.
